crosswalks.label: Project Management Specialists
crosswalks.rationale: Project Management Specialists ground schedule/dependency/communication coordination while software-release evidence and candidate identity are narrower.

crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software Developers provide the technical software context but not release-governance authority.

findings.summary: Software Release Management combines coordination with exact technical candidate/evidence state; neither project-management authority nor code mergeability proves release readiness.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make release coordination, specialist acceptance, exact candidate identity and institutional merge/deploy authority explicit separate surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Software Release Manager reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
